note: Contract addresses below are the CURRENT live deployment, verified on-chain against PlatformRegistry.erc721Template() / erc1155Template() at registry 0x32977E…. An earlier v3.1 snapshot of this file listed template addresses 0x791ca…/0xa0bb3…, legacy templates 0x2481…/0xEFd2…, and a standalone Claim singleton 0x32c4EF… — a chain regenesis wiped those and they now hold ZERO code. The live registry clones the two templates below; claiming is signature-based (mintSigner + relayer), so there is no standalone Claim contract in the current deployment.
changes: GASLESS relayed claiming (v3.1). The EventContract721/1155 templates include a `relayer` role (owner-changeable via setRelayer) and `claimTicketFor(recipient,[typeId,]claimHash,signature)`: the platform relayer broadcasts and pays the gas, so the holder mints the NFT for 0 GMB and only signs a free off-chain ownership message. The mintSigner signature binds the recipient, so a compromised relayer cannot redirect a mint; on-chain usedClaims[claimHash] + DB nftClaimed make double-mint impossible. The original client-pays `claimTicket` is preserved on-chain (route disabled). New events clone the ACTIVE templates below.

EventContract721.type: template (EIP-1167) — ACTIVE, cloned by the registry

EventContract1155.type: template (EIP-1167) — ACTIVE, cloned by the registry

configuration.relayer: Separate broadcasting wallet (backend RELAYER_KEY). Each V3 clone's relayer role defaults to the platform and is re-pointed to this wallet by the backend at event setup (setRelayer); owner-changeable.
configuration.claimFlow: GASLESS: holder signs a free off-chain ownership message -> backend POST /api/claim/relay -> mintSigner signs (contract,[typeId,]claimHash,recipient) -> relayer broadcasts claimTicketFor() and pays gas -> NFT minted to the holder for 0 GMB. Original client-pays claimTicket preserved (route disabled).
configuration.payments: All payments via GembaPay (contracts are payment-agnostic); 0 platform fees
configuration.gas: Negligible — GembaBlockchain native gas ~0; relayer sponsors mint gas so holders pay/sign nothing on-chain
configuration.nft: Multi-page NFT — poster image + on-chain event details (attributes) + interactive QR page (animation_url)
